verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents a native data export feature, though the free plan caps it at 10 exports (docs-33). It also documents an asynchronous bulk API for retrieving large amounts of data (docs-2), record and module enumeration APIs covering standard and custom modules (docs-11, docs-12), and COQL queries (docs-4). Together these support extracting CRM data, but nothing confirms complete account export or the output formats. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of open export formats (e.g., CSV/JSON), proof that a full-account export covers all data (attachments, metadata, relationships), clarity on export limits beyond the free plan, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a clean exit.
